description:
[Trading Data API] Fair Value Gap zones (standard ICT/LuxAlgo) with CE (50%), gap size, age, fill status, distance from price — Fair Value Gap zones (standard ICT/LuxAlgo) with CE (50%), gap size, age, fill status, distance from price. Standard timeframes match TradingView candles. Crypto or stocks.

**Example:** `/v1/fvg?symbol=BTC&timeframe=1h`

include_filled.description: Optional. true to include filled FVGs (default false = active only).

lookback.description: Optional. Timeframe candles to analyze (default 120, max 500).

min_gap_pct.description: Optional. Filter out gaps smaller than this % of price (default 0 = all).

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, NVDA, SPY (or any with &class=).

name: fvg
